tells.1: 'I found myself doing the usual things' is a stock reflective opener, and the polished, balanced contrasts ('Some lessons... others...') end on a neatly bittersweet closing line.
tells.2: The tidy parallel structure and the bittersweet closing kicker ('I was ready to go, but I took my time') feel generically crafted and lack any specific memory.
tells.3: It shares the same abstract, evenly balanced reflection and neat closing line. Its only change is splitting the semicolon, so it still has no concrete names or moments.

reason: Version 4 grounds the reflection in specific details: Amina Yusuf, her daughter, period 4 AP Chem and the elephant toothpaste demo. It also admits something slightly unflattering, which feels authentically human. The other three are near-identical, polished but generic reflections that close on a tidy, sentimental line.
